highlights: 【重要：请手动升级浏览器插件至 1.0.2】更新服务不会自动更新已加载的扩展；替换原扩展目录文件，再到 chrome://extensions 或 edge://extensions 点击重新加载。不同浏览器个人资料需要分别升级。
修复已登录且能够聊天的账号因缺少 hatch_vml / hatch_gw 被旧插件错误阻止导入的问题；所有导入端与服务端现在只要求 hatch_sess。
油猴脚本同步升级至 1.1.2；重新导入后请点击账号“测试”。导入成功只表示记录已保存，实际可用性仍以上游会话验证为准。
保留无效会话 HTTP 401 拒绝和 unavailable 未确认状态；不会将凭据齐全或导入成功误报为账号可用。
highlights_en: IMPORTANT: manually upgrade the extension to 1.0.2. Updating the service does not update unpacked extensions. Replace files in the original folder, then click Reload at chrome://extensions or edge://extensions. Upgrade each browser profile separately.
Fixed valid logged-in accounts being blocked when hatch_vml or hatch_gw was absent. All importers and the server now require only hatch_sess.
Updated the userscript to 1.1.2. Re-import, then run the account Test. Import success means the record was saved; upstream verification determines usability.
Invalid sessions still fail with HTTP 401, while unavailable remains inconclusive. Cookie presence or import success is never proof of a working account.
